description: Attaches an event listener. The value is a method reference (receives the event) or an inline statement.
Special variable holding the native event inside inline handlers, e.g. `@input="update($event)"`.
`.prevent`, `.stop`, `.self`, `.once`, `.capture` and `.passive` handle common DOM event details declaratively. Order matters when chaining.
`@keyup.enter`, `@keydown.esc`, `.ctrl.enter`, `.exact`... filter keyboard events by key and system modifiers.
